[[File:PokeTV.png|250px|thumb|Flipping through programs in Poké TV's segment]] {{Samename|former service that used to show Pokémon episodes|Pokémon TV}} '''Poké TV''' (Japanese: '''ポケTV''' ''POKéTV'') is a segment that occurs after the ending of episodes belonging to the [[Pokémon the Series: XY#Japanese seasons|''XY&Z'' saga]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}, featuring programs about {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. It was featured from [[XY094]] to [[XY139]], and was preceded by [[Professor Oak's Pokémon Holo Caster]] and was succeeded by [[Poké Problem]]. The segment starts off by switching through channels until one is chosen for the episode. Each segment features a Pokémon from the selected program.
